prompt: Which handoff at the gate would give the woman the uninterrupted stretch she wants?
promptZh: 在門邊怎麼接手牽繩，才能讓女士一路牽到她想去的地方？

options.text: Start from the shelter and have her hold the lead while opening the garden gate.
options.zh: 從遮棚出發，讓她牽著狗開花園門。
options.whyZh: 起點應在門的另一側；她也不能一邊牽繩一邊開門。

options.text: Start beyond the gate, have him open it for her, and hand her the lead on the paved side.
options.zh: 從門的另一側開始，由他開門，在鋪面那側把牽繩交給她。
options.whyZh: 他先開門讓她通過；在鋪好的另一側交接牽繩，讓她一路牽到遮棚，不必同時操作門閂。

options.text: Start beyond the gate and have her open it while holding the lead.
options.zh: 從門的另一側開始，讓她一邊牽狗一邊開門。
options.whyZh: 起點對，但她不能一邊牽狗一邊開門。

options.text: Give her the lead at the shelter and open the gate for her when they reach it.
options.zh: 在遮棚把牽繩交給她，到了門邊再替她開門。
options.whyZh: 這會從遮棚開始，不是她想要的從另一側牽回遮棚。

evidence:
I can use the walking frame with one hand on pavement, but I can’t hold the leash and release that gate latch. The gate won’t stay open. Yesterday Patch circled behind me on the long leash.
The garden walkway is paved through the gate. The trail by the river begins across wet grass. Oh, the online album lets us add captions, but the clips play without sound.
I want to lead him from the far side of the garden gate all the way to the shelter. Could we start over there?
explanationZh: 他先開門讓她通過；在鋪好的另一側交接牽繩，讓她一路牽到遮棚，不必同時操作門閂。

vocabulary.note: work 在此是操作機械零件，不是工作。
